claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 28 August 1866, p. 1, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
LIVERPOOL, Aug. 27.—Ship Universe, Capt. Hut-
ton, from New York, July 31, arrived at this port to-
day. Ship M. Post, has also arrived.
